items.item_text: American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross Basic Life Support (BLS), or UC Davis Health CPR
Licensed by the State of California as Certified Phlebotomy Technician
Medical Assistant (MA) or Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification or Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) certification or Paramedic certification
At least two (2) years recent experience as EMT, Paramedic, or Medical Assistant with certified phlebotomy technician license (CPT).

The Emergency Trauma Technician provides ancillary support to both the nursing and medical staff within the Emergency Department. The Trauma Technician performs ECGs, wound Irrigations, wound preparation/bandaging, CPR, Inventory and secure patient valuables, patient transports, assist and obtain vital signs, track and monitor equipment maintenance, inventory and order supplies, assist in equipment set-up ie, suture trays, surgical trays, splints, c-spine Immobilization, oxygen set-up, postmortem care, teaching patient crutch walking and cast care. Assists nursing and medical staff in other duties as required.
Familiar with principles of asepsis and hand hygiene.
Ability to read, write, speak and understand the English language and utilize medical terminology appropriately.
Ability to set priorities and organize work.
Ability to work accurately and quickly under pressure.
Basic knowledge of anatomy and physiology.

Skills and knowledge to work with all department equipment, tools, IE, EKG, monitoring and diagnostic equipment, life support equipment/ambu-bags, gurneys, compressed air tanks, oxygen set-up, trays, packs with instruments, tongs, tubing, solutions, and supplies.
Ability to anticipate the needs of patient appropriately.
Ability to communicate concisely to all co-workers and patients.
